Question 1
?

The velocity v of a particle P at time t is given by v(t)=⟨et,−2e−2t,1⟩. Find the tangential component of acceleration at time t.

a
et−2e−2tet+2e−2t+1
b
 e2t−8e−4te2t+4e−4t+1
c
 et−8e−2te2t+4e−4t
d
 e2t−e−2te2t+e−2t
e
 et+e−2tet+1
Submit
